scope: Same eight v6 arithmetic cases and two repetitions; strict result envelopes. Designed format regression, not independent blind semantic validation.
stop_rule: Execute the fixed 16 candidate schedule with two stages and at most one source-existence recheck per candidate. Stop the entire batch on declared unsupported-schema, endpoint or authentication HTTP failures; record all remaining cases as not run. No fallback, network retries, output repair or mid-batch tuning.
review_basis: Expected statuses fixed from declared Observation boundaries before any model call; labels and case ids are never passed to the model.
